variants.name: Snap the Attack
variants.role: Snap the attack before anything else touches it

options.tip: Attack +3-5dB, Sustain neutral. Do this before compression, always.
Attack 3, Release 2 — use as a light transient nudge if you skip SPL.

variants.name: Exaggerate Before Smashing It
variants.role: Exaggerate the hit before you smash it

options.tip: Attack +6-8dB — push hard, you're about to compress it into oblivion anyway.

variants.name: Soften for the Pocket
variants.role: Soften slightly for that laid-back trip-hop pocket

options.tip: Attack neutral to -2dB, Sustain +3dB for a rounder, warmer hit.

variants.name: Round It Off
variants.role: Round it off — Questlove pocket lives in a softer, fatter hit, not a sharp click

options.tip: Attack -2 to -4dB, Sustain +2-3dB for a fatter, rounder body on kick and snare.

variants.name: Light Transient Touch
variants.role: Keep it natural — you're playing live

options.tip: Very light touch, +1-2dB attack max, just enough to cut through a room mix.

variants.name: Saturation / Grit
variants.role: This is the character stage — where 'Deftones drum bus' lives

options.tip: Drive input +4-6dB for tape compression + harmonic grit before the compressor.
Push the input hard for a fuzzy, transistor-saturated top end.
Alternative/parallel tape saturation — flutter + wow on for extra wobble.

variants.name: Tape Warmth
variants.role: The wobble/warp that defines this vibe

options.tip: Drive gently, enable wow/flutter for pitch drift character.
Alternative — dial in visible flutter for a hazier, dreamlike wobble.

variants.name: Analog Warmth
variants.role: Rhodes/tape warmth — the neo-soul half of this chain

options.tip: Gentle drive, light wow/flutter — just enough to feel analog, not obviously warped like the psych-trip-hop chain.
Alternative — keep flutter subtle here, this is warmth not wobble.

variants.name: Bus Glue Compression
variants.role: Cohere the kit into one punch

options.tip: Ratio 2:1, slow attack, auto release, 1-3dB GR.
4:1, medium attack, 2dB GR — the classic 'glue' setting.

variants.name: Heavy Bus Compression
variants.role: Squash it flat, let it breathe/pump

options.tip: All-buttons-in style, fast attack/release, blend 40-60% wet for NY-compression pump.
Ratio 4:1+, fast attack, 6-10dB GR for real pumping.

variants.name: Glue Compression
variants.role: Gentle, musical cohesion — not a squash

options.tip: 2:1, slow attack, auto release, 1-2dB GR — smooth and musical.
Light 2:1 setting if you want a brighter alternative.

variants.name: Pocket Glue
variants.role: Smooth, musical glue that keeps the groove sitting deep in the pocket

options.tip: Slow attack, moderate release, 2-3dB GR — the classic smooth-soul glue compressor.
Alternative — even smoother, more vintage-soul character, less obviously 'compressed.'

variants.name: Gentle Compression
variants.role: Control dynamics without squashing feel

options.tip: 4:1, medium attack, moderate release, 2-3dB GR max.

variants.name: Tone / EQ
variants.role: Shape low-end weight and top-end snap

options.tip: HP at 40Hz, small boost 3-5kHz for stick snap.
Use only if you don't have a dedicated EQ open — Timeless 2's filter can do a gentle tilt in a pinch.

variants.name: Aggressive EQ
variants.role: Carve space, add aggression

options.tip: Boost 2-4kHz hard for snare/click aggression, HP 50-60Hz.
Alternative character EQ — musical top-end boost.

variants.name: Warm Body EQ
variants.role: Boost the low-mid body that makes the drums feel 'thick,' not muddy

options.tip: Gentle boost 150-250Hz for body, small dip 400Hz to avoid boxiness, soft top-end roll-off above 9kHz.

variants.name: Tone Shaping
variants.role: Warm low-mid, rolled-off harsh highs

options.tip: Gentle low shelf boost ~100Hz, high shelf cut above 10kHz for that dusty trip-hop top end.

variants.name: EQ for Live Cut-Through
variants.role: Carve room for the kit in a live mix

options.tip: HP 80Hz, gentle presence boost 2-3kHz.

variants.name: Modulation / Movement
variants.role: The psychedelic swirl

options.tip: Slow, subtle rate — tremolo/phaser blend on parallel bus for a breathing, psychedelic motion.
Slow LFO sweep, low resonance, for a filtered dream-wash on toms/percussion.

variants.name: Subtle Shimmer
variants.role: A whisper of movement — Rhodes-adjacent, not psychedelic-wide

options.tip: Very low depth, slow rate, chorus-leaning blend on a parallel bus — should be felt, not noticed.

variants.name: Glitch Send (subtle)
variants.role: One or two stutter/reverse moments per bar, on a send

options.tip: One or two short stutter triggers per phrase, tempo-synced, gate mix low (20-35%) so it reads as an accent, not a gimmick.
Backup option — short 1/32-1/16 delay with high feedback, automate the mix in/out to fake a stutter roll if Kilohearts isn't loaded.

variants.name: Texture Accent (light touch)
variants.role: One glitch moment per section max — texture, not a genre statement

options.tip: Very occasional, low mix — a single stutter on a fill into a chorus, not a recurring effect. This chain is about groove, not glitch.

variants.name: Glitch / Stutter Send
variants.role: Chaotic breaks, reversed hits, filter chokes

options.tip: Stutter set to fast/chaotic mode into Bitcrush for a genuinely crushed, bar-synced chaos edit on fills — this is the real deal, not a fake-out.
Backup/parallel layer — extreme feedback + ping-pong + reverse mode for chopped fill moments.

variants.name: Delay Throws
variants.role: Three-part transition-style tails (Frank Ocean-esque)

options.tip: Dotted-8th ping-pong, moderate feedback, filtered repeats — automate a throw at section transitions.

variants.name: Delay
variants.role: Trip-hop haze layered on top of the foundation

options.tip: Dotted-8th, filtered repeats, moderate feedback — same washy-transition move, used more sparingly.

variants.name: Room / Space
variants.role: Glue the kit into the mix without washing out the transient

options.tip: Short pre-delay, 0.8-1.2s decay, low mix (8-15%).
Room algorithm, HF damping up, keep it under the transient designer stage in the signal path (post-EQ, parallel send).

variants.name: Space / Crush
variants.role: Lo-fi width and decay

options.tip: Short decay, high mix on chorus hits only (automate).
Synced slap-back for aggressive fill tails.

variants.name: Space (Wide, Hazy)
variants.role: Wide, hazy, but controlled

options.tip: Long-ish decay (1.5-2.5s), heavy pre-delay, low-passed return for a hazy back wall.
Hall/plate blend, damp highs for warmth.

variants.name: Space (Grounded)
variants.role: Warm room, not a hazy wash — keep the groove grounded

options.tip: Shorter decay than a wide wash (0.8-1.4s), moderate pre-delay, low-passed return.

variants.name: Minimal Room
variants.role: Just enough space to feel natural outdoors/on stage

options.tip: 5-10% mix only — for a festival/busking set, less reverb reads clearer outdoors.
